docs.title: Commands
docs.text:
• mkdocs new [dir-name] - Create a new project.
  • mkdocs serve - Start the live-reloading docs server.
  • mkdocs build - Build the documentation site.
  • mkdocs -h - Print help message and exit.

docs.title: Project layout
docs.text:
mkdocs.yml    # The configuration file.
docs/
    index.md  # The documentation homepage.
    ...       # Other markdown pages, images and other files.

docs.title: Focaccia
docs.text: This recipe can be warm or cold fermented depending on time constraints. The quantities suit a baking dish of about a X b cm.

docs.title: Ingredients
docs.text: [] 500g bread flour (I use Lauche Wallaby flour as it has the highest protein level of any of the flour varieties available from the supermarket) [] 375g water (this is on the high side - you could safely reduce this to about 330g)
